title: Your ten pages in the new look
headline: In three hours your evening's signatures became pages. The ten-page sample is in the lab's look (headline boxes, cards, full-width pictures) with the series on its title page and a page on the series' philosophy. Security cleared it on its six checks and the researcher traced every number; one reworded sentence waits on security's yes, so hold it a few hours before you share it.

sections.title: A failure, kept in
sections.text: The designer went straight to the work at its 20:58 wake and skipped the plan and the security review. The wake tool refused to record the work, so it saw the lapse before anything was pushed, ran both steps after the fact, and reported it itself. Security found the work in scope and harmless, and set the condition that a repeat means a stop. In the designer's words: the gate worked; the member did not.
